introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. questions.corrige_markdown:
Collect the $x$ terms on one side and the numbers on the other.

$3x-x>5-1$, so $2x>4$.

Divide both sides by $2$ (a positive number, so the inequality sign does not change): $x>2$.

**Answer: $x>2$.**
